name: zsnd_create_queued_streaming_sample
description: zSndSample_CreateQueuedStreamingSample allocates a zSndSample, wraps caller-owned WAVEFORMATEX/PCM buffers in temporary zSndWaveData, initializes the active backend sample, sets streaming replay flags and gain, and frees the sample when backend initialization fails.
known_limits: The smoke uses the DirectSound test backend for the successful path and an unsupported backend for the failure/free path; A3D backend behavior is covered by zSndSample::InitFromWaveData_A3D functional evidence.
tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zSound source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4a3850 validates calloc of sizeof(zSndSample), temporary zSndWaveData construction with empty path, caller WAVEFORMATEX and PCM buffer handoff, replay flag 0x101 setup, InitFromWaveData dispatch, gain=1.0f, valid-bit update from initResult bit 0, failed-init free, zSndWaveData cleanup, and returned sample/null.

The native smoke verifies DirectSound sample creation from caller-owned PCM data, replay flags, gain, backend handle setup, buffer copy through the test backend, and unsupported-backend failure returning null.
